ibanHelpToggle: Where do I find my IBAN?
ibanHelpIntro: Open your bank app and go to Accounts (not Cards). Tap your GEL account and look for the account number — most apps have a copy button next to it.
ibanHelpTbc: TBC app → Accounts → your GEL account → account details. It’s the number starting with GE…TB.
ibanHelpBog: BoG mBank app → Accounts → your GEL account → details. It starts with GE…BG.
ibanHelpFormat: An IBAN is 22 characters and always starts with GE. Spaces don’t matter — paste it as it is.
